title: San Diego Selected to Welcome Matches for the LA28 Olympic Soccer Tournaments
description: San Diego has been selected as one of seven cities nationwide that will welcome matches for the LA28 Olympic Football (Soccer) Tournaments. Matches will be played at Snapdragon Stadium (which will be known as San Diego Stadium), home of San Diego FC, San Diego Wave Football Club, and San Diego State University. This announcement reflects San Diego’s growing soccer community, our world-class venue, and readiness to be part of the LA28 Games when they come to the United States in 2028.
